tools.description: List supported acceptance templates and their negotiable terms.
tools.name: list_templates

tools.description: Buyer: propose an order extraction agreement from the original CSV text.
tools.name: propose_agreement

tools.description: List the caller's jobs and current-version acceptance status.
tools.name: list_jobs

tools.description: Read current agreement terms, original source, status and started deadlines.
tools.name: get_job

tools.description: Provider: counter an unlocked agreement's repair window to 5 or 10 minutes.
tools.name: counter_agreement

tools.description: Accept the current agreement version for this process's identity only.
tools.name: accept_agreement

tools.description: Buyer: confirm simulated funding and start the first-submission deadline.
tools.name: fund_job

tools.description: Provider: submit delivery records for deterministic checking and private storage.
tools.name: submit_delivery

tools.description: Read an immutable check report, settlement status and terminal receipt.
tools.name: get_result

tools.description: Challenge current check provenance, or record a provider's failure dispute.
tools.name: challenge_result

tools.description: Buyer: retrieve the current delivery only after confirmed simulated release.
tools.name: retrieve_delivery
